changelog: BIM-Bot v2.6.0 — Navisworks Manage support (230 MCP tools) + no-admin updates. NEW: 21 navis_* tools for Navisworks Manage (model search, viewpoints, selection sets, Clash Detective run/results/status/report, append NWC/NWD, NWD export, color overrides) over a parallel direct plugin service alongside Autodesk Revit. NEW: Claude Desktop + ChatGPT MCP configs (mcp-config.claude.json / mcp-config.chatgpt.json) and in-Navisworks AI chat using the same API-key providers as Revit. FIX: in-Revit updates no longer trigger a Windows admin-password (UAC) prompt — per-user install default with /CURRENTUSER updates. Note: Navisworks plugin DLL is built separately on a full Manage install (see NAVIS_SETUP.md); this installer ships the Revit plugin + MCP server with navis_* tools ready.
